result.reason: The customer right is within the fallback because Commerce One can extend the notice period only to 60 days, and prepaid post-termination fees are refunded. However, the retained renewal language lets the Vendor end the relationship at the end of a term on only 30 days' notice, rather than the fallback-required 90 days. The Vendor-election parenthetical is also awkward and does not specify when or how the election must be made, although the redline is otherwise targeted and preserves unrelated terms.
